checks.must: Texts still come from the same ngx-translate keys/files (via TranslateService passed in or shared), not hard-coded strings.
Text re-renders when the language changes at runtime (onLangChange subscription or equivalent), with the subscription cleaned up, or the gap is flagged.
Date and currency use the app's LOCALE_ID (de-DE) formatting like Angular's date:'longDate' and currency pipes, not the browser default locale, or differences are flagged.
New order values from the async pipe re-render React (wrapper passes @Input changes via ngOnChanges/re-render) and handle the initial null from async.
The React root is unmounted in ngOnDestroy.
No unrequested behaviour changes without calling them out.
